reviews.text: Located across from Odaiba Seaside Park, this restaurant is perfect for dog owners. It's easy to enter because it's named after the park and almost all the customers have dogs. We always share the taco rice and gapao rice for lunch. Highly recommended!

This is one of my favorite restaurants, and I've been there many times.

I'm so happy that I can spend time with my dog ​​both on the terrace and inside the restaurant. They even provide water and a menu for dogs, making it very convenient. The sofa seating is spacious and comfortable.

The food is stylish, delicious, and reasonably priced, which is another attractive point.

I happened to find it when I took my dog ​​for a walk at the seaside park.
I had just been to the Asakusa one the other day, so I was surprised to find one here too.
There were lots of customers there.
0 unfortunately isn’t possible
It took a while because there was only one employee.

I'm a regular customer.

Dogs are welcome not only on the terrace but also inside the restaurant.

They have a dog menu and water available, and even sofa seating.

The food is reasonably priced for Odaiba and thoughtfully prepared.
It's delicious.

This time I had the curry, but I usually get the loco moco, which is also delicious.

One suggestion: there's no place to attach dog leashes.
Everyone puts their dogs in carts.

It was Sunday lunchtime, so there was a long line of people waiting outside, and it was quite lively. We were seated about 30 minutes after signing our names on the waiting list. Water for both humans and dogs is self-service, and orders are placed at the table using a QR code on your smartphone. The staff who brought our food were very friendly, and the food was quite tasty. Our dog seemed very happy with the chicken sticks from the dog menu.
The staff are so friendly, and they always compliment me on how cute I look every time I go. Even though it's a cafe, the food is substantial and I highly recommend it! ✨

On Sunday, we attended an event in Odaiba, and afterwards, we were looking for a place to eat with our dogs, so we went into this restaurant. However, there was no greeting like "Welcome." There were empty tables, so we were unsure whether we should sit down. Other customers who arrived later seemed to be in the same situation.

Once we sat down, we were simply handed a bill and instructed to "order using the QR code." We wondered, "What about people without smartphones?" and then, "Huh? Aren't they going to bring us water?" We noticed a water dispenser next to the register and, following the example of other customers, poured ourselves some.

They may have been busy, but a little more announcement would have been appreciated.

It was a shame, because the atmosphere, food, and prices were all good.

I was having trouble deciding just by looking at the products online, so I went to the store. I found the bag I wanted, was able to get a feel for the size, and was glad to find a matching pouch. I'm also happy with the cute dog waste bags that came as a purchase bonus. It was a fun shopping experience, watching the dogs trying on clothes and even getting to pet them!

It's located on my dog's walking route, and when it's not crowded, the staff come out and pet me whenever I pass by. 🐶

All the food is delicious. They have a wide selection of dog-friendly menu items, and I often order takeout.

It makes me so happy to see that all the staff love dogs.

They also have a lot of stylish apparel, so it's fun just to browse.

The staff didn't even say "Welcome," they just kept stocking shelves.

It completely ruined my desire to buy anything.
This dog cafe is a place I always stop by on my way home from events, but it's always crowded. There's a waiting time. Parking tickets are available.

This is my second visit.
After lunch, I always buy clothes and goods at the shop. 🤭
It had been over a year since my last visit, and I was disappointed to see that the photo spot that used to be there had been replaced with a table. 😢
The food was satisfying, and they have a great selection of dog-friendly menu items. ☺️

I went with my dog.
It was so cold that I was able to bring him inside the restaurant, which was very helpful.
Seats on the terrace in the middle of winter are hellish...
The food was nothing special (lol)

I visited with my pug.
They have a cafe as well as a shop.
I used the cafe and they also have dog food.
I ordered two chicken sticks, which I ate completely.
They had a homemade feel, but I ate a little, but it was tasteless (lol).
For lunch, I ordered gapao rice, loco moco, and omelet rice.
Everything was delicious with a strong flavor.
I loved the laid-back atmosphere, which made me lose track of time.
I'll be back.
I ordered grilled chicken curry.
The appearance doubled my appetite.
The vegetables were plump and sweet.
The curry sauce was slightly spicy, but had a hint of sweetness that made it delicious.
I'll definitely be back, but I still want to try their other dishes.

I go here to buy clothes and accessories for my dogs.
You can also have tea or a meal inside the store.

This is one of my favorite dog cafes because it has a great atmosphere, is comfortable, and easy to enter.

My dog ​​loves the meat dishes on the dog menu ໒ ෆ · ෆ ১
The human food and drinks are also delicious ☺️

I was looking for a dog-friendly cafe in Odaiba when I happened to pass by this one. A lovely staff member tending to flowers near the entrance kindly told me that dogs were welcome, so I went in. Since it was a weekday morning before lunch, I was able to relax and enjoy a light snack inside. The female staff member at the adjacent merchandise shop was very kind and provided wonderful service, making for a very pleasant experience.

Also, I was grateful to receive a cute etiquette bag when paying. Thank you very much.
The world revolves around dogs 😄🐶 …

In my experience, pet-friendly restaurants often don't put much effort into their food, or only allow pets on the terrace, making them less pet-friendly. However, this place is perfect in both aspects.

The food is delicious. This time, we ordered chicken curry, taco rice, and fried food. We also got chicken and tofu sticks for the dogs. The dogs seemed to enjoy their meal. It seems to have many repeat customers, so it's probably best to make a reservation, especially during lunchtime. There's also a pet shop attached, so you can pass the time while waiting. It's one of my favorite places lately!

The food was simply delicious. The portions were generous!

The restaurant is a bit small, but you can bring in a cart if you're considerate …

I always stop by here when I go for a walk in Odaiba.

It gets pretty crowded on weekends, so weekdays are a good time. …
Even though it's a cafe that seems to only attract dog owners, they require customers to "feed your dog on the floor." I got the impression that the owner is quite spiteful. …

I ate at this restaurant before.

They said dogs were allowed, and I was glad that I was able to enter even though …
